definitions.gloss: Imari ware: porcelain from the Arita area, shipped from Imari
definitions.explanation: Porcelain made in and around Arita in Saga Prefecture from the early 1600s and named after the port of Imari, from which it was shipped. Famous for richly colored designs and exported to Europe in large quantities.

examples.japanese: {伊万里焼|いまりやき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧。
{伊万里焼|いまりやき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{伊万里焼|いまりやき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王侯貴族|おうこうきぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{愛|あい}された→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
examples.english: Old Imari ware was prized even by European royalty and nobility.

notes:
{伊万里焼|いまりやき} and ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧ largely name the same porcelain: Imari was the shipping port, Arita the place where it was made. Today ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧ is used for ware made in Arita, and {伊万里焼|いまりやき} for ware made around Imari, while {古伊万里|こいまり} means the old Edo-period pieces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伊万里焼|いまりやき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{器|うつわ}→器：11838_utsuwa⟧: Imari tableware
- {古伊万里|こいまり}: antique Imari ware
- {色絵|いろえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伊万里焼|いまりやき}: enameled Imari ware
